title: Frozen-time, loudness and contact-sheet scripts
what_it_does: Three tiny ffmpeg scripts: find near-frozen stretches in a render, report integrated loudness/true peak/short-term LUFS, and tile a contact sheet.
when_to_use: Mechanical checks before a critic looks at the film.
why: 7 to 9 lines each, no dependencies. Check hyperframes `measure`/`audio` first: install only the frozen-time one if those do not cover it.
